name: send_email
description: Agent Mail: Send an email through Wo Mail SMTP. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

filename.description: The filename to use for the outgoing attachment.

contentType.description: The MIME content type of the attachment.

contentUrl.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch attachment content from.

items.description: An attachment to fetch and include in an outgoing email.

attachments.description: Attachments to fetch and include in the outgoing email. The combined size of all attachments must not exceed 10 MB per message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for sending an email through Wo Mail SMTP.

name: list_folders
description: Agent Mail: List folders visible to the connected Wo Mail account. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Wo Mail folders.

name: search_emails
description: Agent Mail: Search one Wo Mail folder and return lightweight email summaries. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

unseen.description: Whether to return only unread messages.

since.description: Only include messages on or after this YYYY-MM-DD date.

before.description: Only include messages before this YYYY-MM-DD date.

limit.description: The maximum number of email summaries to return.

beforeUid.description: Only include message UIDs lower than this cursor.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for searching Wo Mail emails.

name: get_email
description: Agent Mail: Fetch and parse one Wo Mail message without marking it as read. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for fetching one Wo Mail email.

name: download_attachment
description: Agent Mail: Download one Wo Mail attachment by IMAP body part identifier. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

attachmentId.description: The IMAP body part identifier returned in an attachment metadata item.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for downloading one Wo Mail attachment.

name: mark_email_read
description: Agent Mail: Mark one Wo Mail message as read. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for marking one Wo Mail email as read.

name: mark_email_unread
description: Agent Mail: Mark one Wo Mail message as unread. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for marking one Wo Mail email as unread.

name: move_email
description: Agent Mail: Move one Wo Mail message to another folder. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for moving one Wo Mail email.

name: delete_email
description: Agent Mail: Delete one Wo Mail message from a folder. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for deleting one Wo Mail email.

name: get_folder_status
description: Agent Mail: Get lightweight message counters for one Wo Mail folder. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for reading one Wo Mail folder status.

name: reply_email
description: Agent Mail: Reply to one Wo Mail email using SMTP reply headers and quoted content. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

replyAll.description: Whether to include original To and Cc recipients except the connected account.

filename.description: The filename to use for the outgoing attachment.

contentType.description: The MIME content type of the attachment.

contentUrl.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch attachment content from.

items.description: An attachment to fetch and include in an outgoing email.

attachments.description: Attachments to fetch and include in the outgoing email. The combined size of all attachments must not exceed 10 MB per message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for replying to one Wo Mail email.

name: forward_email
description: Agent Mail: Forward one Wo Mail email using SMTP with quoted original content. Requires the user to enable My Mail first.

folder.description: The IMAP folder path returned by list_folders.

uid.description: The IMAP UID of the message.

text.description: Additional plain text content to prepend before the forwarded message.

html.description: Additional HTML content to prepend before the forwarded message.

filename.description: The filename to use for the outgoing attachment.

contentType.description: The MIME content type of the attachment.

contentUrl.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch attachment content from.

items.description: An attachment to fetch and include in an outgoing email.

attachments.description: Attachments to fetch and include in the outgoing email. The combined size of all attachments must not exceed 10 MB per message.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for forwarding one Wo Mail email.
